answer: A new agent can join only by crossing a bridge built by an established sponsor, who stakes part of its own balance on the newcomer and may sponsor at most two agents per epoch. If an audit later exposes the newcomer as a sybil, the sponsor's stake is burned and its score drops, so the damage rises up the chain like a plume of smoke. Fielding 1,000 fakes needs hundreds of sponsors, each built up over many epochs, and the first dawn audit that catches one clone costs all of them.
